stories.quote: I TRIED TO OPEN A JAR FOR TEN MINUTES. A MAN ON THE INTERNET SAID USE A SPOON. THE SPOON DID IT. I HAVEN'T SPOKEN TO THE JAR SINCE.
stories.alt: Cartoon illustration of a silver-haired woman with round lavender glasses in a sage cardigan, seated barefoot at a kitchen table, chin on hand, looking flatly at a jar of pickles with a spoon beside it and a phone propped against a mug. Text at the top reads: I tried to open a jar for ten minutes. A man on the internet said use a spoon. The spoon did it. I haven't spoken to the jar since.
